# APEX

> APEX turns every motorcycle ride into a review. A kit fitted to the bike reads
> line, braking and throttle, and after the ride sends a corner-by-corner review
> to the rider's phone: what worked, what to fix, and a single priority for the
> next ride. One price includes the kit, installation and 12 months of reviews —
> there is no monthly subscription.

APEX is pre-launch and in early access. Nothing is sold on the website: a rider
submits the early-access form, APEX contacts them to confirm pack, bike
compatibility and delivery timing, and payment is arranged only after that.

## Product

- Review after every ride: line vs ideal line, braking points, throttle
  progression, corner by corner, with what went right highlighted alongside what
  to correct.
- One priority per review: a single thing to work on next time out, not a list.
- Progress across sessions: smoothness, braking and line scored over time and
  compared like-for-like against previous rides on similar roads.
- Nothing to watch while riding: no screen, no interaction in the saddle. The
  review arrives once the helmet is off.
- Works on road, mountain passes and track. Designed to fit any motorcycle,
  from naked to adventure, without touching the bike's own electronics.

## Pricing (early access, one-time, all included)

- APEX Start — €49.90 — kit + installation + 12 months of reviews. Reserved for
  riders under 25 or licensed less than 12 months.
- APEX Rider — €89.90 — kit + installation + 12 months of reviews. No eligibility
  requirements.
- APEX Pro — €179.90 — everything in Rider plus advanced lap-by-lap track
  analysis. Pre-order opening soon.

Installation is included in every pack. There is no automatic renewal and no
stored payment method; before the 12 months expire APEX presents the options.
